title: Matrix amplification preserves scalar-defect realizations
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $A,C$ finite-dimensional central simple $K$-algebras, $x\in H^2_{\mathrm{cont}}(\operatorname{Gal}(K^s/K),(K^s)^\times)$, $n>0$, and $f:C\simeq_K\operatorname{Mat}_n(A)$. If $A$ realizes $x$ in the matrix scalar-defect relation [def-sc-brauer-scalar-defect], then $C$ realizes the same $x$.

source.place: Section 03R1, scalar-defect construction following Lemma 03R6 and preceding Theorem 03R7; Section 0DVG

proof.text: Unpack the scalar-defect realization into a size d>0, splitting e, locally constant lift b, and cocycle z. Construct the entrywise scalar-extension equivalence using TensorProduct.piRight twice. Its preservation of multiplication follows by tensor induction and the matrix multiplication sum. Extend f to the separable closure, apply this equivalence, apply e entrywise, flatten by Matrix.compAlgEquiv and reindex with finProdFinEquiv. This is the explicit splitting of C of size n*d>0.

Compose the diagonal ring homomorphism Matrix.scalar (Fin n) on Mat_d(Ks) with the flattening equivalence, and apply Units.map. This is a monoid homomorphism on invertible matrices, equal to the reindexed I_n Kronecker b. Entrywise calculation proves it commutes with Galois action and sends scalar units to the same scalar unit in size n*d.

Compose the original locally constant b with this fixed monoid homomorphism. Apply diagonal_mul and mul_diagonal to each outer matrix entry of the descent identity and then apply flattening. Apply the same monoid homomorphism to the original multiplication-defect equation, using its Galois-action and scalar compatibilities. The original z and its homology-image equation complete the realization of C. Every step is implemented and proved in the Lean module.
